facts.business: Rajshree Polypack Limited manufactures rigid plastic sheets and thermoformed packaging products for dairy, food and beverages, bakery, confectionery, fruits, vegetables, sweets, snacks, and electronics.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Continue improving profitability through better product mix and operational efficiency
Optimise utilisation of existing manufacturing capacities while expanding injection moulding capabilities
Strengthen export presence and deepen relationships with key domestic and international customers
Continue to expand and strengthen the portfolio of value-added and sustainable packaging solutions
Scale Olive Ecopak by increasing customer approvals and improving capacity utilisation

key_risks: Geopolitical developments causing temporary disruptions to export demand
Property title deeds in previous company name (Rajshree Polypack Private Limited) pending change
